text:
anya: Heads-up — assembling the docs release digest for next Tuesday. Need PRs finalized: #412, #417, #421. Focusing on: SDK snippet polish, migration guide for Dedicated->Private, and known issues section.
ben: I'll finish the Python snippets in #417 today. Any tests I should run?
anya: Thanks — run the snippet in the quickstart sample app (examples/quickstart/python). Mainly verify streaming + function calling example.
kevin: I fixed the TypeScript snippet indentation in #412. Pushed a tiny change to the README.
marisol: I noticed two broken links in the migration guide (anchors changed after the refactor). I'll open a PR for link-checker updates.
docs-bot: link-checker report: 2 broken links found — /docs/dedicated/legacy-config and /docs/api/old-embeddings. Created ticket #789.
anya: Marisol, can you patch both anchors and add redirects? We want /docs/dedicated/migration -> stays live.
marisol: Yep, doing redirects + anchor fixes. Also adding a short note under 'Known issues' about token truncation during quantized runs.
oliver: On the changelog blurb: should we call the feature "Smart routing for tiered fallbacks" or "Tiered routing"? Shorter is better.
kevin: "Tiered routing" reads cleaner in the bullet list. Use the full name in the deep-dive page.
ben: For Python snippet, I swapped to the new SDK client API: `from redwood import RedwoodClient` — updated example. Paste below:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('gpt-open-7b', prompt='Summarize: ...')
print(resp.text)
```

anya: Nice. Include a note about streaming chunk handling (async iterator example) and a small note about token cost differences between models.
marisol: PRs ready: #417 (py snippets), #418 (redirects + anchor fixes), #421 (known-issues copy). Requesting reviews from @anya and @kevin.
anya: Reviewing now. Quick checklist: examples run locally, links pass link-checker, changelog entry <80 chars, known issues have reproduction steps.
kevin: Found a nit in #421 — "embedding units" phrasing. Suggest "per-embedding unit" for clarity.
anya: Agreed. Marisol, can you update wording and add a short repro for the token truncation bug (steps + example command)?
marisol: Updated wording and added repro with `curl` example. Also added a temporary note: 'workaround: pin sequence_length=1024 in dedicated config'.
ben: Once merged, I'll update the SDK snippet in the Node examples too — ensure parity.
anya: Great. Plan: merge PRs by EOD today, run docs build in CI, and draft the release digest bullets. I'll write the blurb and ping product for review.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: failed — error: broken link /docs/api/old-embeddings not found
anya: Marisol — that link-blocker shows up again in preview. Can you re-run the redirect PR?
marisol: Re-ran redirect PR and force-pushed. CI re-triggered.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: success — site build passed. Preview at https://deploy-preview-148.docs.redwood.ai
anya: Perfect. I'll assemble release digest now and post in #announcements tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :tada:
